በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
እከየ: እከይ — evil (noun; construct 'evil of') · construct before its dependent noun (እከየ ምግባሪሁ 'the evil of his deeds')
ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
ለይሁዳ: ይሁዳ — to Judah (ለ- + proper name; marking the object after ባረኮ 'he blessed')
ተነበዩ: ተነበየ — they prophesied (3mp perfect, tä-stem, n-b-y)
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
በእንቲአሁ: በእንተ — for his sake (በእንተ + -hu, variant በእንቲአሁ)
ለብእሲ: ብእሲ — to/of a man, someone (ለ- + noun)
እኪት: እኩይ — evil, wicked (adjective, fem. እኪት; masc. እኩይ)
ወይገብእ: ገብአ — and it will return, pass (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
ወትወርድ: ወረደ — and it goes down (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, G, w-r-d); the second ወ is part of the root
ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
ተነበየ: ተነበየ — he prophesied (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነበየ, n-b-y)
ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')
የሐውር: ሖረ — he walks, goes (3ms imperfect, ḥ-w-r)
ዘኢኮነ: ኮነ — who was not (ዘ- 'who' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect G, k-w-n)
ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ወይሁብ: ወሀበ — and he gives (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, w-h-b)
ትእምርተ: ትእምርት — sign, token (noun, fem., accusative) · construct 'sign of' (ትእምርተ ሕይወት 'sign of life')
ዘከመዝ: ዘከመዝ — such, thus, in this way (ዘ- + ከመ + ዝ)
ነገረ: ነገር — word, matter, affair (noun, construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word, a matter' (ንንግርከኑ ነገረ 'may we tell you a matter?'; ch. 53) · ነገረ — he spoke, said (3ms perfect, G, n-g-r; ነገረ እንዘ ይብል 'he spoke, saying')
ላዕሌየ: ላዕለ — upon me, against me (preposition ላዕለ + -የ '1cs me', ላዕሌየ)
ዘይሴሰይ: ሴሰየ — what one eats (ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms imperfect of the quadriliteral ሴሰየ 'eat, take food')
አንሥአ: አንሥአ — he raised up, lifted (3ms perfect, causative a-stem)
ሰኰናሁ: ሰኰና — his sole, foot (noun + -ሁ 'his'; ሰኰና properly 'hoof, sole'; read here as 'feet', the singular used collectively (?))
ለውእቱ: ውእቱ — of that, that (ለ- 'of, to' + demonstrative ውእቱ before a noun: ለውእቱ መጽሐፍ 'of that book') · ለ- marking the object before a demonstrative (ይነጽሮ ለውእቱ ሥዕለ 'let him look at that image')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
ስብሐተ: ስብሐት — praise, hymn (noun f., accusative; construct 'praise of')
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ፍርሀተ: ፍርሀት — fear (construct 'fear of') · also accusative, object: ያአትት ፍርሀተ 'he removes fear'
ቅድመ: ቅድመ — before (preposition, construct) · adverbial 'forward' (ቅድመ ወድኅረ 'forward and back')
ፀዋግ: ፀዋግ — wretched, base (adj.); sense uncertain: elsewhere in this text it names a low fellow, and in a Proverbs 6:12 citation a worthless man
ይትፌሥሕ: ተፈሥሐ — he rejoices (3ms imperfect, tä-stem, f-ś-ḥ)
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?) · 'except' before a number (ዘእንበለ ፻ወ፳ ዓመት 'except for a hundred and twenty years') · 'except only' with ዳእሙ (ዘእንበለ ዳእሙ ዘያሠርጽ 'except only what he sows') · 'without' before a noun (ዘእንበለ ኀፍረት 'without shame')
ላዕሌሁ: ላዕለ — upon, over (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form ላዕሌ-) · 'against' (ወቀንኡ ላዕሌሁ 'and they envied him', lit. 'against him', ch. 95) (?)
ዲቤሁ: ዲበ — upon him, upon it (preposition, stem ዲቤ- + -ሁ '3ms')
ወይከውን: ኮነ — and it will be (ወ- + 3ms imperf., k-w-n)
ዘጽሑፍ: ጽሑፍ — what is written (ዘ- relative + passive participle ጽሑፍ)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
እምታሕተ: ታሕተ — from under, under (እም- + preposition ታሕተ)
እምኔሁ: እም — from (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form እምኔ-) · 'than it', in comparison (ልብሰ ዘይኄይስ እምኔሁ 'a garment better than it')
ይትሀጐል: ተሀጕለ — he/it perishes (3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ሀጕለ)
ወይሬኢ: ርእየ — and he saw (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, used as a narrative past)
ወይጠፍእ: ጠፍአ — and it will perish (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ṭ-f-ʾ)
እምድር: ምድር — from the earth (እም- + ምድር, the doubled ም written once; the Hebrew of 1 Samuel 2:8 has 'dust', this text does not)
ነዋኀ: ነዋኅ — far, long (adjective; accusative used as an adverb 'far')
ይጠፍእ: ጠፍአ — he/it vanishes, perishes (3ms imperfect, G, ṭ-f-ʾ)
ስምዑኒ: ሰምዐ — hear me! (G 2mp imperative with suffix 1cs -ኒ)
ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
ወስርቅ: ስርቅ — and theft (ወ- + noun; also ሥርቅ)
በየማኑ: የማን — at his right hand (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ይንሣእ: ነሥአ — that he take (3ms subjunctive, G)
ባዕድ: ባዕድ — another, a stranger (adjective/noun; ብእሲተ ባዕድ 'another man's wife') · 'strange, foreign' (አማልክተ ባዕድ 'strange gods')
ለይኩን: ኮነ — let it be (ለ- jussive particle + 3ms jussive ይኩን, k-w-n)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this' · ኵሉ ዘ- 'all who' (ኵሉ ዘሞአ 'all who conquered')
ይቅትል: ቀተለ — that he kill (3ms subjunctive, G, q-t-l)
ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
በእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — on this account, concerning this (በእንተ + ዝ, preposition + demonstrative)
ሕግ: ሕግ — law (noun) · collective 'laws' after a plural demonstrative (ለእሉ ሕግ ወአስማት 'these laws and names')
ፍትሐ: ፍትሕ — judgment, justice (noun, accusative) · construct 'judgment of' (ፍትሐ ሕዝበ አምላከ እስራኤል 'judgment of the people of the God of Israel')
ጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — righteousness, justice (noun; ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness')
ይወፅእ: ወፅአ — he/it goes out (3ms imperfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
ስነኒሁ: ስን — his teeth (plural ስነን, oblique ስነኒ- + -ሁ '3ms his')
በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am') · 'of, from' after ሰአለ (ሰአሉ በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'they asked of God')
ድልው: ድልው — fitting, ready, due (adjective, masc. sg.)
ሊተ: ሊተ — to me, me (1s pronoun, dative/oblique)
